categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in mobile communication technology services, including communication network optimization, network engineering, network design and planning, and network maintenance services. It also develops and sells related products such as system products and virtual reality digital content. The company has expanded into 5G application business and virtual reality immersive experiences based on IP licensing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced mobile communication technologies including 2G to 5G network optimization, network big data analysis systems, and digital twin technologies. It employs cloud computing, AI, XR (extended reality), and UWB (ultra-wideband) positioning technologies for immersive VR experiences. The company uses a comprehensive service model integrating testing, evaluation, optimization, and network re-planning, supported by proprietary software and hardware solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major telecom operators such as China Mobile, and equipment manufacturers like Huawei and ZTE. The company serves the telecommunications industry primarily, with growing involvement in digital economy sectors including virtual reality and 5G-enabled industry applications. It also targets overseas markets including Thailand and Sri Lanka.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with significant business in economically developed regions such as East China, North China, Central China, Southwest China, Northwest China, South China, and Northeast China. It has also expanded overseas with subsidiaries and operations in Thailand, Sri Lanka, Hong Kong, South Africa, and Myanmar.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the telecommunications supply chain, providing third-party technical services including network optimization and maintenance to telecom operators and equipment manufacturers. It does not manufacture core telecom equipment but offers integrated technical services and solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening mobile communication technology services, expanding 5G and 5G-A network applications, and developing immersive digital economy products such as virtual reality content based on licensed IPs like 'The Three-Body Problem'. The company invests significantly in R&D for 5G-A network optimization, AR/VR communication integration, UWB positioning, and digital twin technologies to enhance service capabilities and explore new business models.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service contracts obtained via bidding processes, including network optimization and engineering services. Additional revenue streams include sales of system products, rental income from property, and emerging virtual reality experience services. The company also earns investment income and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the longest-established and largest third-party professional network optimization service providers in China, holding a stable market share with strong technical expertise and extensive regional coverage. It competes in a highly fragmented and competitive market with many small-scale players, leveraging its integrated service capabilities and long-term relationships with major telecom operators and equipment vendors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 690.9 million, a slight decrease of 2.06% year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 78.48 million, a significant decline compared to the previous year. The company has total assets nearing RMB 970 million and net assets of about RMB 580 million. Despite recent losses, it maintains stable business scale and is investing in new growth areas such as 5G applications and virtual reality.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive and integrated mobile communication technology service capabilities, combining extensive industry experience with advanced network optimization technologies. Its unique value lies in providing end-to-end network optimization solutions synchronized with evolving telecom standards, coupled with innovative digital economy products like immersive VR experiences based on popular IPs. The company’s strong regional presence and stable partnerships with leading telecom operators and equipment manufacturers further differentiate it in the market.
